comments:
In spite of the title on the cover page of instance (ID:4832), is not a commentary of or introduction to the Prasannapadā (ID:3724). The incipit refers to a "general introduction to teaching the dharma" (chos bshad la 'jug pa spyi'i don). The text lists Madhyamaka treatises, gives biographies of Nāgārjuna (ID:3720) and Candrakīrti (ID:3725), etc. but does not actually engage with the Prasannapadā (ID:3724).

The author composed a dBu ma tshig gsal gyi bsdus don, see (ID:7588).
